title: Big meteor over Åland the day after the June trip

tellings.quote: So, it was on the news that the big meteor over Åland and over here.

plain: A Swedish treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg says his team found an odd shape on the floor of the Baltic Sea, between Sweden and Finland. He told podcast host Jesse Michels that in June 2025, the day after a trip out to the site, a big meteor was reported on the news over Åland, a group of islands in that sea, and over the area. He tells it as one more strange thing tied to the spot.
